bullets: New: When the tool opens, it asks for your name. Pick yours, or add it if you're new. Your name shows at the top; press it to switch user.
New: On a Clinic Eligibility file, the ticks and notes you save on Clinic Work carry the name you picked.
New: This bell, next to refresh and full screen, shows what changed in the tool. Hover over any of them to see what it does.
